subtitle: A Blue Flag beach in central Albufeira reached by tunnel, elevator, and stairs, whose namesake boulder may be demolished to keep the beach safe.
spike_statement: Storms cracked the sandstone boulder that names Praia do Peneco, and on 20 Feb 2026 Albufeira's mayor said it may, in principle, be demolished.

levers.photo_tone: Pale limestone cliffs and a cracked ochre boulder under flat Atlantic light, the tunnel's dark mouth in the foreground.
